prompt: Create a precise sparse Chinese heritage ink LINE DRAWING of the Eastern Jin Cuan Baozi stele: upright ancient weathered rectangular stone slab, gently uneven upper corners and worn inscription field, simple flat stone plinth. Image 1 is the subject photo and image 2 is the project's line plate style reference. Follow the subject's actual silhouette and defining forms, removing glass cases, glare, signs, people, floors and modern backgrounds. Center the complete stone object with ample blank margin. Only clean fine charcoal-black contour lines and a few sparse material or relief marks. Represent inscriptions as abstract nonlegible marks; do not invent Chinese characters or text. Every blank canvas pixel must be flat opaque #FFFFFF. No gray background, gradients, shadows, paper grain, watercolor, colored ink, filled black masses, checkerboard or transparent canvas. 3:4 portrait composition.
